name: Vegetables
overview: Scripture reveals that vegetables and herbs are part of God's provision for mankind's sustenance, as seen in His gift of seed-bearing herbs and fruits for food (Genesis 1:29). Even after the flood, God affirmed the use of green herbs for nourishment (Genesis 9:3), and the Israelites recalled the vegetables they ate in Egypt, such as cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic (Numbers 11:5). The Bible also values the simple blessing of a meal of herbs shared in love over abundance without it (Proverbs 15:17), while imagery of growth and fruitfulness in gardens points to God's work in bringing forth righteousness (Isaiah 61:11). Additionally, Ezekiel's instruction to prepare bread from various seeds and legumes highlights the practical and symbolic significance of plant-based foods in God's provision.
